# RunAround

> Virtual running races in Townsville, North Queensland. Runners log in with Strava, GPS-match published Road or Trail courses, and appear on race-window and overall leaderboards.

RunAround is a free community site. Admins publish courses with a GPX file. Matching uses GPS coverage (and an optional Strava segment on older races). Emails go out when a runner gains a place, and when a race window closes.

Canonical race URLs are `/races/:id` (legacy segment ids still work as slugs). Private areas (`/admin`, `/me`, `/login`, `/onboarding`) are not for crawlers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://runaround.com.au/): Live and upcoming races
- [Races](https://runaround.com.au/races): All published Road and Trail boards
- [About](https://runaround.com.au/about): What RunAround is and how to enter
- [Contact](https://runaround.com.au/contact): How to get in touch
- [Luen Warneke](https://runaround.com.au/about/luen-warneke): Site builder
- [Sidney Willis](https://runaround.com.au/about/sidney-willis): Series founder (Hungry Runner Coaching)

## Crawler files

- [robots.txt](https://runaround.com.au/robots.txt): Crawl policy
- [sitemap.xml](https://runaround.com.au/sitemap.xml): Indexable URLs
- [humans.txt](https://runaround.com.au/humans.txt): Credits
